punchline: Same colleague, two rooms, two very different people on display.
thirty_sec: Liz Wiseman watched a colleague named Brian present to two leaders at Oracle: diminished before one, fully capable before the other. Moments like that started the research behind Multipliers.
question: Who on your team speaks freely elsewhere but goes quiet when you enter?
key_contrast: The person did not change between meetings; the person across the table did.
